In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 1.5 m

and plinth with Cement mortar 1:6 (1 cement : 6 coarse sand)

After commissioning of plant necessary testing to be done for the satisfactory of Engineer Incharge. Note : Refer the ANNEXURE : F for Detailed Specification of Each components - For 1000 LPH SS : Skid Type
